name: gull-wing-four-sided
title: Gull-wing package, four sides
summary: Quad flat gull-wing package (QFP): a moulded body on its standoff and formed leads on all four sides that leave it at mid-height, bend down and end in a flat foot on the seating plane; the body cut round the lead roots, rounded corners and top edges and a pin-1 dimple (leads, leads_short, pitch, body_length, body_width, body_height, standoff, span, span_x, lead_width, lead_thickness, foot_length; the bends, rounds and dimple derived from them).
provenance: Original work: the in-code gull-wing builder's construction (crates/solidcraft-integration/src/models/gull_wing.rs, retired with this file) made parametric in its counts, saved through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` at an LQFP-48 of 7 × 7 mm, 0.5 mm pitch (JEDEC MS-026 proportions); the gull-wing generator gives every dimension. Estimated bends, rounds and dimple; no vendor drawing or EDA/CAD library data copied.
